profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Senior software engineer with real-time embedded flight software and testbed/simulation experience. Proven expertise supporting Lockheed Martin Space and NASA Langley Research Center.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently supporting the Testbed and Simulation team at Lockheed as product owner for the ASPIN IRAD simulator. Formerly created and tested models for an LM400 IRAD spacecraft simulator.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software developer on Orion, supporting the Artemis II mission. Technical lead in charge of GPS IIIA flight software release activities, including presentations, regression testing, and coordinating with other subsystem leaders. Flight software test conductor and integrator for commercial A2100TR projects. Provided flight software mission operations support for the HellasSat 4, Arabsat-6A, and GPS III SV02 launches. Assisted in developing and reviewing the Software Development Plan for the Enterprise Flight Software (EFSW) Product Line.

positions.title: Associate Computer Scientist
positions.description: Supported NASA Langley Research Center's Flight Software Systems Branch as a software engineer for the Stratospheric Aerosol and Gas Experiment III on International Space Station (SAGE III on ISS) flight project (launched February 2017) and the Safeguard project (selected as NASA Langley's submission for the NASA 2018 Software of the Year Award). Primary responsibilities were to develop, integrate, unit test, document, and peer review real-time embedded software written in C and C++. Experience authoring and executing formal test procedures, as well as developing and verifying software requirements. In addition to the flight software written in C and C++, also developed two flight operations ground software tools written in Java.

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description: Interned in the Flight Software Systems Branch. Developed, integrated, tested, and reviewed code to enable streaming of non-critical telemetry for the Stratospheric Aerosol and Gas Experiment III on International Space Station (SAGE III on ISS) flight project. Investigated, tested, and resolved issues with predicting solar and lunar events.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description: Interned in the Systems Integration and Test Branch. Implemented a remote cleanroom monitoring system, enabling faster response to anomalies and preventing damage to flight hardware. Analyzed cleanroom temperature, relative humidity, and particle count data to prepare monthly performance reports.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

honors.title: Extraordinary Engineering and Technology Award
honors.description: Received a group award for contributions to releasing a critical flight software update prior to the Arabsat-6A launch.
honors.issuer: Issued by Lockheed Martin Space Engineering & Technology · Jun 2019

honors.title: Employee of the Month
honors.description: Received for sacrificing personal time off in support of program milestones, as well as stepping up to cover for a sick co-worker.
honors.issuer: Issued by Enterprise Flight Software Product Line · Feb 2019

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteer at nursing home. Paired with one resident to just spend time with her and provide company. Also helped with various tasks such as cleaning her room, sorting stamps for her collection, and putting groceries away.
Volunteer at nursing home. Primarily assisted with weekly bingo nights, but also spent time visiting with residents and painting fingernails.
